notes.title: 2023.11.23 Update notes
notes.notes: Fixed an issue where reading a save would cause skills to disappear

notes.title: 2023.11.22 Update notes
notes.notes:
◆ New Princess Skills: You can choose one skill for each upgrade.
◆ Added a unique character: ★ King of the Brave (camp refresh)
◆ New Civilian Character: ★ Village Chief, Bow/Stick, (Level Refreshed Randomly)

notes.title: 2023.11.15 Update notes
notes.notes: Fixed an issue where it was possible to switch levels

notes.title: 2023.11.13 Update Notes
notes.notes:
Goal for achieving Marksman League achievements reduced from 15 to 10
Maps now have new boss indicators
The number of difficulties has now been reduced from 7 to 6, and all difficulties will be opened after clearing the difficulty, and the difficulty level of each level will be adjusted accordingly
The number of objective levels per week has been reduced from 8 to 7
Added defense mode and active attack mode, and adjusted the mode switch function to the right mouse button
The queue panel is now adjusted to Esc key for outgoing calls

Bug Fixes:
Fixed an issue where the Holy Maiden's skills were abnormal for a period of time after entering a new scene

notes.title: 10.30 Update
notes.notes: The stuttering issue has been preliminarily fixed, and we apologize for the bad game experience for all players. We will continue to follow up on follow-up questions, thank you for your understanding and support.
